title: Odesa — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Odesa: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Odesa has a population of 1,015,000. A charming Black Sea port city known for its 19th-century architecture, beaches, and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 149 sunny days a year.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
